base, foundation, ῥ. πάντων καὶ βάσις ἁ γᾶ ἐρήρεισται Ti. Locr. , cf. ; base of a vertical pillar, ; τῶν λόφων.
Math., root or base of a series, Anatolius ap.. (Aeol.βρίζα (q.v.): cf. Goth. waúrts, Lat. radix.)
